# Big Top Self Storage

> Modern self storage in Basildon, Essex. Smart-entry units (your phone is the key), 24/7 CCTV, open 8am–8pm every day. £1 for your first 6 weeks.

Big Top Self Storage offers personal, business and student storage units from 25 to 300 sq ft on Harvey Road, Basildon (SS13 1ET). Units are booked online in minutes and accessed via a smartphone app — no padlocks or keys required.
